name: chalkboard-agent-service
description: Chalkboard Master — regular socket user with WebMCP tools (Gemini 3.6) — no MCP, no plugins

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='SYSTEM_INFO.md';const dest='dist/SYSTEM_INFO.md';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('[build] Copied SYSTEM_INFO.md to dist/')}"
